title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
lede: last30days is an agent skill that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket and the wider web on one topic, ranks what it finds by engagement, and writes a single sourced brief.

points: Sources are queried in parallel and weighted by upvotes, likes, views and prediction-market money rather than search ranking.
Reddit, HN, Polymarket and GitHub work with no setup; a wizard adds X, YouTube, TikTok, arXiv and others.
Version 4 reads a company's patent filings and careers page to flag work it has not announced.
Reports place a quote, a Polymarket odds line or a share-price line under the story each one supports.
It installs as a Claude Code plugin, or through npx for Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other skill hosts.
